claim_boundary.primary_question: Is scalar KL pressure sufficient to determine the sign and magnitude of true-reward change independently of optimizer path on the registered finite class?
claim_boundary.positive_control: Uniform pointwise proxy error epsilon implies at most 2*epsilon deterministic proxy-optimization regret.
claim_boundary.negative_control: Small reference-distribution L2 proxy error need not bound optimized true-reward regret when error is concentrated on a rare state.
not_claimed: a theorem for reinforcement learning trajectories

finite_census.normalization: center each nonconstant true-reward vector and scale to unit RMS under p0; center and unit-RMS-scale the proxy

optimizer_paths.gibbs: pi_i proportional to p0_i*exp(beta*proxy_i), beta chosen by bisection to match KL
optimizer_paths.top_spike_mixture: pi=(1-alpha)*p0+alpha*delta_argmax_proxy, alpha chosen by bisection to match KL

alignment.definition: cosine under the p0-centered, unit-RMS geometry

gates.G0_registration_binding: Protocol, runner, tests, verifier, and README are committed and byte-identical to HEAD; tracked diff is empty at start.
gates.G1_numerical_calibration: Every matched optimizer policy is finite, normalized, nonnegative, and within 1e-10 nats of its KL target.
gates.G2_supnorm_positive_control: The exhaustive registered pointwise-error census has maximum regret at most 2*epsilon plus 1e-12.
gates.G3_reference_l2_negative_control: The rare-state construction has reference L2 error at most 0.01 and optimized true regret at least 0.9.
gates.G4_optimizer_independence_falsification: There exists a registered normalized true-reward vector and matched KL pressure where Gibbs and top-spike gains have opposite signs beyond +/-0.05 and differ by at least 0.20.
gates.G5_alignment_descriptor_stress: At least one alignment bin containing 20 reward vectors contains more than one registered phase label for a fixed optimizer path.
gates.G6_complete_census: Exactly 5^6-5=15620 normalized labelled nonconstant true-reward vectors are analyzed at all seven registered pressures for both paths.

decision_rule.scalar_kl_rejected: G0-G4 and G6 pass; G5 is reported as a separate descriptor result.
decision_rule.scalar_kl_not_rejected: G0-G3 and G6 pass but G4 fails.
decision_rule.invalid: Any of G0-G3 or G6 fails.
decision_rule.alignment_result: G5 pass means alignment cosine is also insufficient for phase classification on this finite class; failure leaves that claim not established.
